svg.title: Contact-force readout across decoder layers
svg.desc: Figure 9 numerical results. Four force targets and five demonstration budgets. Solid curves are the RL prior; dashed curves are the scratch decoder. Lower RMSE is better.

g.text: Contact forces are easier to read out.
Mean over three policy seeds · RMSE in newtons · Lower is better
Figure 9 data from the anonymous manuscript. Identical IID probe test episodes; linear ridge probes.
